desc: Derive the structural reduction and candidate formulas: positive weights imply an optimal chordless path, the interval-disjoint graph is P5-free so paths have at most 3 edges, and 2-edge/3-edge candidates reduce to 1D range minima.

Implement and validate the O(N+Q) bounded-hop range-min solution: build min-weight arrays by L and R, prefix minima for R < x and suffix minima for L > y, answer direct/2-edge/3-edge candidates with strict inequalities and INF, and check against brute force on random small instances.
